content.short: InsurAce is a decentralized multi-chain insurance protocol providing risk protection across numerous protocols.
content.description: InsurAce began in April 2021 as a decentralized protocol offering portfolio-based cover protection for blockchain users. It provides insurance across more than 60 protocols on eight or more chains, including Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, BNB Chain and Arbitrum. Through pricing optimization, the platform seeks to lower costs by up to 60% versus other protocols while reducing gas fees by as much as 50%. This multi-chain approach gives users a single, integrated way to safeguard diverse DeFi activity with tailored coverage.
